rule.status: post-hoc robustness check designed on 14 Oct 2026 after the benchmark was known; APNet unchanged; all outcomes reported

protocol.input: EA (R^-1/2 of the subject's label-free mean covariance of up to 300 windows), as d_tricks / APNet
protocol.training: SWA 20 epochs, average of the last 8; AdamW lr 0.001, wd 0.01, batch 64, class-weighted CE, AMP; CBraMod fine-tune backbone lr x 0.1
protocol.test_time: AdaBN per subject (no-op without batch-norm) + option none/center chosen per (model, dataset) on validation
protocol.not_given: IG-TCAI, within-task ranking, label smoothing (APNet's own components)

rule.apnet: seed-0 sealed predictions of d_v3_ls with the option locked in v4_lock.json (not retrained)

tests.H-F1 (primary): per dataset: APNet (seed 0) vs each recent model under the APNet protocol (seed 0); two-sided Wilcoxon over held-out subjects; Holm over the 4 recent models within the dataset; alpha 0.05
tests.statement rule: 'APNet outperforms X under equal conditions on D' only if Holm p < 0.05 and the mean difference > 0; 'X outperforms APNet' only if Holm p < 0.05 and the mean difference < 0; otherwise 'no significant difference'
tests.H-F2 (descriptive): each recent model: APNet protocol vs its default FINAL run (two-sided Wilcoxon, no claim): does the protocol help it?
tests.also reported: APNet 3-seed and EEGNet + EA + AdaBN [SWA] 3-seed for reference (no test)

rule.selection: only the score option of each recent model is chosen, on validation subjects, before the test is read
